title: Operationalizing Responsible AI in MLOps and ML Production: A Systematic Literature Review
abstract: arXiv:2611.06961v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled systems are increasingly deployed in operational environments where machine learning (ML) models interact with changing data, users, infrastructure, and organizational processes. While Responsible AI principles are widely discussed, less is known about how these principles are translated into concrete mechanisms within Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) and ML production workflows. This paper reports a systematic literature review of studies that operationalize Responsible AI in ML production. The review synthesizes evidence across monitoring and runtime assurance, audit and compliance, ML lifecycle integration, and traceability/provenance/documentation. Across the final study set, the literature shows a shift from abstract ethical principles toward engineering mechanisms such as drift monitoring, runtime checks, audit logs, provenance records, evidence bundles, governance gates, policy-as-code, mode

translated_title: 在MLOps与机器学习生产中落地负责任人工智能：一项系统性文献综述
translated_abstract: 启用人工智能（AI）的系统越来越多地部署于实际运行环境中，其中机器学习（ML）模型需要与不断变化的数据、用户、基础设施和组织流程进行交互。尽管负责任AI（Responsible AI）原则已被广泛讨论，但这些原则如何在机器学习运维（MLOps）和ML生产工作流中被转化为具体机制，目前仍知之甚少。本文报告了一项针对在ML生产中落地负责任AI相关研究的系统性文献综述。该综述综合了监测与运行时保障、审计与合规、ML生命周期集成以及可追溯性/来源记录/文档化等方面的证据。在最终的研究集合中，文献显示出从抽象伦理原则向工程机制转变的趋势，例如漂移监测、运行时检查、审计日志、来源记录、证据包、治理门、策略即代码等机制。
tldr: 本文通过系统性文献综述发现，负责任AI在MLOps和ML生产中正从抽象伦理原则转变为具体的工程机制，通过漂移监测、运行时检查、审计日志、治理门和策略即代码等技术手段落地实施。
en_tdlr: This systematic literature review reveals that Responsible AI is shifting from abstract ethical principles toward concrete engineering mechanisms in MLOps and ML production, operationalized through drift monitoring, runtime checks, audit logs, governance gates, and policy-as-code.
